rule.title: Verifiable Source Grounding and Citation Metadata
rule.statement: Every retrieved chunk injected into the LLM context must carry immutable provenance metadata (documentId, documentTitle, pageNumber, sheetName).
rule.rationale: Enterprise RAG platforms must provide auditability and verifiable citations so users can cross-check AI claims directly against source documents.
rule.implementation_guidance: Format retrieved chunks in the system prompt with citation tags: [Source: {title}, Page: {page}, Sheet: {sheet}] {content}.

forbidden.example: Concatenating raw text chunks into the prompt with no attribution or origin tracking.

preferred.example: Injecting '[Source: Contract.pdf, Page 4] The warranty period is 24 months' into the context prompt.

source.evidence_quote: Preserving chunk provenance from extraction through generation is essential for grounded citations, giving users the confidence to verify generated answers.
